footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Public Storage: includes a $7.2M income tax benefit; after $12.7M attributable to noncontrolling interests, $199M of preferred dividends. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.7% to $4.8B in 2025. Operating income fell 14.3% to $1.8B, a 37.1% margin.
Net income fell 15.3% to $1.6B, or $9.01 per share. Operating cash flow was $3.2B and free cash flow $3.0B, versus $2.9B.
watch: Net income includes a $7.2M tax benefit.
sources: Public Storage Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
